revenue.label: 매출·영업수익
revenue.definition: Amount, excluding tax collected from customer, of revenue from satisfaction of performance obligation by transferring promised good or service to customer. Tax collected from customer is tax assessed by governmental authority that is both imposed on and concurrent with specific revenue-producing transaction, including, but not limited to, sales, use, value added and excise.

operatingIncome.label: 영업이익
operatingIncome.definition: The net result for the period of deducting operating expenses from operating revenues.

netIncome.label: 순이익
netIncome.definition: The portion of profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, which is attributable to the parent.

eps.label: 희석 EPS
eps.definition: The amount of net income (loss) for the period available to each share of common stock or common unit outstanding during the reporting period and to each share or unit that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of common shares or units for all dilutive potential common shares or units outstanding during the reporting period.

operatingCashFlow.label: 영업현금흐름
operatingCashFlow.definition: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activities, including discontinued operations. Operating activity cash flows include transactions, adjustments, and changes in value not defined as investing or financing activities.

assets.label: 총자산
assets.definition: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all assets that are recognized. Assets are probable future economic benefits obtained or controlled by an entity as a result of past transactions or events.

equity.label: 자기자본
equity.definition: Total of all stockholders' equity (deficit) items, net of receivables from officers, directors, owners, and affiliates of the entity which are attributable to the parent. The amount of the economic entity's stockholders' equity attributable to the parent excludes the amount of stockholders' equity which is allocable to that ownership interest in subsidiary equity which is not attributable to the parent (noncontrolling interest, minority interest). This excludes temporary equity and is sometimes called permanent equity.

cash.label: 현금·현금성자산
cash.definition: Amount of currency on hand as well as demand deposits with banks or financial institutions. Includes other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits. Also includes short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Excludes cash and cash equivalents within disposal group and discontinued operation.

currentAssets.label: 유동자산
currentAssets.definition: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all assets that are expected to be realized in cash, sold, or consumed within one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer). Assets are probable future economic benefits obtained or controlled by an entity as a result of past transactions or events.

currentLiabilities.label: 유동부채
currentLiabilities.definition: Total obligations incurred as part of normal operations that are expected to be paid during the following twelve months or within one business cycle, if longer.

longTermDebt.label: 장기차입금(표준 태그)
longTermDebt.definition: Amount after unamortized (discount) premium and debt issuance costs of long-term debt classified as noncurrent and excluding amounts to be repaid within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer. Includes, but not limited to, notes payable, bonds payable, debentures, mortgage loans and commercial paper. Excludes capital lease obligations.

currentDebt.label: 유동성 장기차입금
currentDebt.definition: Amount, after unamortized (discount) premium and debt issuance costs, of long-term debt, classified as current. Includes, but not limited to, notes payable, bonds payable, debentures, mortgage loans and commercial paper. Excludes capital lease obligations.

shortTermBorrowings.label: 단기차입금
shortTermBorrowings.definition: Reflects the total carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of debt having initial terms less than one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

stockCompensation.label: 주식보상비용
stockCompensation.definition: Amount of noncash expense for share-based payment arrangement.

dilutedShares.label: 가중평균 희석주식 수
dilutedShares.definition: The average number of shares or units issued and outstanding that are used in calculating diluted EPS or earnings per unit (EPU), determined based on the timing of issuance of shares or units in the period.

revenue.definition: Amount of revenue recognized from goods sold, services rendered, insurance premiums, or other activities that constitute an earning process. Includes, but is not limited to, investment and interest income before deduction of interest expense when recognized as a component of revenue, and sales and trading gain (loss).

netIncome.label: 순이익
netIncome.definition: The portion of profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, which is attributable to the parent.

eps.label: 희석 EPS
eps.definition: The amount of net income (loss) for the period available to each share of common stock or common unit outstanding during the reporting period and to each share or unit that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of common shares or units for all dilutive potential common shares or units outstanding during the reporting period.

operatingCashFlow.label: 영업현금흐름
operatingCashFlow.definition: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activities, including discontinued operations. Operating activity cash flows include transactions, adjustments, and changes in value not defined as investing or financing activities.

assets.label: 총자산
assets.definition: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all assets that are recognized. Assets are probable future economic benefits obtained or controlled by an entity as a result of past transactions or events.

equity.label: 자기자본
equity.definition: Amount of stockholders' equity (deficit), net of receivables from officers, directors, owners, and affiliates of the entity, attributable to both the parent and noncontrolling interests. Amount excludes temporary equity. Alternate caption for the concept is permanent equity.

cash.label: 현금·현금성자산
cash.definition: Amount of currency on hand as well as demand deposits with banks or financial institutions. Includes other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits. Also includes short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Excludes cash and cash equivalents within disposal group and discontinued operation.

liabilities.label: 총부채
liabilities.definition: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all liabilities that are recognized. Liabilities are probable future sacrifices of economic benefits arising from present obligations of an entity to transfer assets or provide services to other entities in the future.

currentAssets.label: 유동자산
currentAssets.definition: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all assets that are expected to be realized in cash, sold, or consumed within one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer). Assets are probable future economic benefits obtained or controlled by an entity as a result of past transactions or events.

currentLiabilities.label: 유동부채
currentLiabilities.definition: Total obligations incurred as part of normal operations that are expected to be paid during the following twelve months or within one business cycle, if longer.

currentDebt.label: 유동성 장기차입금
currentDebt.definition: Amount, after unamortized (discount) premium and debt issuance costs, of long-term debt, classified as current. Includes, but not limited to, notes payable, bonds payable, debentures, mortgage loans and commercial paper. Excludes capital lease obligations.

shortTermBorrowings.label: 단기차입금
shortTermBorrowings.definition: Reflects the total carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of debt having initial terms less than one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

dilutedShares.label: 가중평균 희석주식 수
dilutedShares.definition: The average number of shares or units issued and outstanding that are used in calculating diluted EPS or earnings per unit (EPU), determined based on the timing of issuance of shares or units in the period.

operatingIncome.label: 영업이익

netIncome.label: 순이익

eps.label: 희석 EPS

equity.label: 자기자본

revenue.label: 매출·영업수익
revenue.definition: Amount of revenue recognized from goods sold, services rendered, insurance premiums, or other activities that constitute an earning process. Includes, but is not limited to, investment and interest income before deduction of interest expense when recognized as a component of revenue, and sales and trading gain (loss).

operatingIncome.label: 영업이익
operatingIncome.definition: The net result for the period of deducting operating expenses from operating revenues.

netIncome.label: 순이익
netIncome.definition: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities; of income (loss) available to common shareholders.

operatingCashFlow.label: 영업현금흐름
operatingCashFlow.definition: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activities, including discontinued operations. Operating activity cash flows include transactions, adjustments, and changes in value not defined as investing or financing activities.

assets.label: 총자산
assets.definition: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all assets that are recognized. Assets are probable future economic benefits obtained or controlled by an entity as a result of past transactions or events.

equity.label: 자기자본
equity.definition: Amount of stockholders' equity (deficit), net of receivables from officers, directors, owners, and affiliates of the entity, attributable to both the parent and noncontrolling interests. Amount excludes temporary equity. Alternate caption for the concept is permanent equity.

cash.label: 현금·현금성자산
cash.definition: Amount of currency on hand as well as demand deposits with banks or financial institutions. Includes other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits. Also includes short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Excludes cash and cash equivalents within disposal group and discontinued operation.

liabilities.label: 총부채
liabilities.definition: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all liabilities that are recognized. Liabilities are probable future sacrifices of economic benefits arising from present obligations of an entity to transfer assets or provide services to other entities in the future.

currentAssets.label: 유동자산
currentAssets.definition: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all assets that are expected to be realized in cash, sold, or consumed within one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer). Assets are probable future economic benefits obtained or controlled by an entity as a result of past transactions or events.

currentLiabilities.label: 유동부채
currentLiabilities.definition: Total obligations incurred as part of normal operations that are expected to be paid during the following twelve months or within one business cycle, if longer.

longTermDebt.label: 장기차입금(표준 태그)

operatingIncome.label: 영업이익
operatingIncome.definition: The net result for the period of deducting operating expenses from operating revenues.

netIncome.label: 순이익
netIncome.definition: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities; of income (loss) available to common shareholders.

eps.label: 희석 EPS
eps.definition: The amount of net income (loss) for the period available to each share of common stock or common unit outstanding during the reporting period and to each share or unit that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of common shares or units for all dilutive potential common shares or units outstanding during the reporting period.

operatingCashFlow.label: 영업현금흐름

assets.label: 총자산
assets.definition: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all assets that are recognized. Assets are probable future economic benefits obtained or controlled by an entity as a result of past transactions or events.

equity.label: 자기자본
equity.definition: Total of all stockholders' equity (deficit) items, net of receivables from officers, directors, owners, and affiliates of the entity which are attributable to the parent. cash.label: 현금·현금성자산

Excludes cash and cash equivalents within disposal group and discontinued operation.

liabilities.label: 총부채
liabilities.definition: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all liabilities that are recognized. currentAssets.label: 유동자산

currentLiabilities.label: 유동부채

longTermDebt.label: 장기차입금(표준 태그)

currentDebt.label: 유동성 장기차입금

shortTermBorrowings.label: 단기차입금

dilutedShares.label: 가중평균 희석주식 수

operatingCashFlow.label: 영업현금흐름
operatingCashFlow.definition: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activities, including discontinued operations. Operating activity cash flows include transactions, adjustments, and changes in value not defined as investing or financing activities.

assets.label: 총자산
assets.definition: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all assets that are recognized. Assets are probable future economic benefits obtained or controlled by an entity as a result of past transactions or events.

equity.label: 자기자본
equity.definition: Total of all stockholders' equity (deficit) items, net of receivables from officers, directors, owners, and affiliates of the entity which are attributable to the parent. The amount of the economic entity's stockholders' equity attributable to the parent excludes the amount of stockholders' equity which is allocable to that ownership interest in subsidiary equity which is not attributable to the parent (noncontrolling interest, minority interest). This excludes temporary equity and is sometimes called permanent equity.

cash.label: 현금·현금성자산
cash.definition: Amount of currency on hand as well as demand deposits with banks or financial institutions. Includes other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits. Also includes short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Excludes cash and cash equivalents within disposal group and discontinued operation.

liabilities.label: 총부채
liabilities.definition: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all liabilities that are recognized. Liabilities are probable future sacrifices of economic benefits arising from present obligations of an entity to transfer assets or provide services to other entities in the future.

stockCompensation.label: 주식보상비용
stockCompensation.definition: Amount of noncash expense for share-based payment arrangement.

dilutedShares.label: 가중평균 희석주식 수
dilutedShares.definition: The average number of shares or units issued and outstanding that are used in calculating diluted EPS or earnings per unit (EPU), determined based on the timing of issuance of shares or units in the period.

netMargin.label: 순이익률
netMargin.definition: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities; of income (loss) available to common shareholders.

revenue.label: 매출·영업수익
revenue.definition: Amount of revenue recognized from goods sold, services rendered, insurance premiums, or other activities that constitute an earning process. revenue.label: 매출·영업수익

Includes, but is not limited to, investment and interest income before deduction of interest expense when recognized as a component of revenue, and sales and trading gain (loss).

netIncome.label: 순이익
netIncome.definition: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities; of income (loss) available to common shareholders.

eps.label: 희석 EPS
eps.definition: The amount of net income (loss) for the period available to each share of common stock or common unit outstanding during the reporting period and to each share or unit that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of common shares or units for all dilutive potential common shares or units outstanding during the reporting period.

operatingCashFlow.label: 영업현금흐름
operatingCashFlow.definition: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activities, including discontinued operations. Operating activity cash flows include transactions, adjustments, and changes in value not defined as investing or financing activities.

assets.label: 총자산
assets.definition: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all assets that are recognized. Assets are probable future economic benefits obtained or controlled by an entity as a result of past transactions or events.

equity.label: 자기자본
equity.definition: Amount of stockholders' equity (deficit), net of receivables from officers, directors, owners, and affiliates of the entity, attributable to both the parent and noncontrolling interests. Amount excludes temporary equity. Alternate caption for the concept is permanent equity.

cash.label: 현금·현금성자산
cash.definition: Amount of currency on hand as well as demand deposits with banks or financial institutions. Includes other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits. Also includes short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Excludes cash and cash equivalents within disposal group and discontinued operation.

liabilities.label: 총부채
liabilities.definition: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all liabilities that are recognized. Liabilities are probable future sacrifices of economic benefits arising from present obligations of an entity to transfer assets or provide services to other entities in the future.

currentAssets.label: 유동자산
currentAssets.definition: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all assets that are expected to be realized in cash, sold, or consumed within one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer). Assets are probable future economic benefits obtained or controlled by an entity as a result of past transactions or events.

currentLiabilities.label: 유동부채
currentLiabilities.definition: Total obligations incurred as part of normal operations that are expected to be paid during the following twelve months or within one business cycle, if longer.

stockCompensation.label: 주식보상비용

Excludes cash and cash equivalents within disposal group and discontinued operation.

liabilities.label: 총부채
liabilities.definition: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all liabilities that are recognized. Liabilities are probable future sacrifices of economic benefits arising from present obligations of an entity to transfer assets or provide services to other entities in the future.

currentAssets.label: 유동자산
currentAssets.definition: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all assets that are expected to be realized in cash, sold, or consumed within one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer). currentLiabilities.label: 유동부채

stockCompensation.label: 주식보상비용

revenue.label: 매출·영업수익
revenue.definition: Amount of revenue recognized from goods sold, services rendered, insurance premiums, or other activities that constitute an earning process. Includes, but is not limited to, investment and interest income before deduction of interest expense when recognized as a component of revenue, and sales and trading gain (loss).

operatingIncome.label: 영업이익
operatingIncome.definition: The net result for the period of deducting operating expenses from operating revenues.

netIncome.label: 순이익
netIncome.definition: The portion of profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, which is attributable to the parent.

eps.label: 희석 EPS
eps.definition: The amount of net income (loss) for the period available to each share of common stock or common unit outstanding during the reporting period and to each share or unit that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of common shares or units for all dilutive potential common shares or units outstanding during the reporting period.

operatingCashFlow.label: 영업현금흐름
operatingCashFlow.definition: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activities, including discontinued operations. Operating activity cash flows include transactions, adjustments, and changes in value not defined as investing or financing activities.

capex.label: 유형자산 투자
capex.definition: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of long-lived, physical assets that are used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale; includes cash outflows to pay for construction of self-constructed assets.

assets.label: 총자산
assets.definition: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all assets that are recognized. Assets are probable future economic benefits obtained or controlled by an entity as a result of past transactions or events.

equity.label: 자기자본
equity.definition: Amount of stockholders' equity (deficit), net of receivables from officers, directors, owners, and affiliates of the entity, attributable to both the parent and noncontrolling interests. Amount excludes temporary equity. Alternate caption for the concept is permanent equity.

cash.label: 현금·현금성자산
cash.definition: Amount of currency on hand as well as demand deposits with banks or financial institutions. Includes other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits. Also includes short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Excludes cash and cash equivalents within disposal group and discontinued operation.

liabilities.label: 총부채
liabilities.definition: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all liabilities that are recognized. Liabilities are probable future sacrifices of economic benefits arising from present obligations of an entity to transfer assets or provide services to other entities in the future.

currentAssets.label: 유동자산
currentAssets.definition: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all assets that are expected to be realized in cash, sold, or consumed within one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer). Assets are probable future economic benefits obtained or controlled by an entity as a result of past transactions or events.

currentLiabilities.label: 유동부채
currentLiabilities.definition: Total obligations incurred as part of normal operations that are expected to be paid during the following twelve months or within one business cycle, if longer.

dilutedShares.label: 가중평균 희석주식 수
dilutedShares.definition: The average number of shares or units issued and outstanding that are used in calculating diluted EPS or earnings per unit (EPU), determined based on the timing of issuance of shares or units in the period.

revenue.label: 매출·영업수익
revenue.definition: Amount, excluding tax collected from customer, of revenue from satisfaction of performance obligation by transferring promised good or service to customer. Tax collected from customer is tax assessed by governmental authority that is both imposed on and concurrent with specific revenue-producing transaction, including, but not limited to, sales, use, value added and excise.

operatingIncome.label: 영업이익
operatingIncome.definition: The net result for the period of deducting operating expenses from operating revenues.

netIncome.label: 순이익
netIncome.definition: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities; of income (loss) available to common shareholders.

eps.label: 희석 EPS
eps.definition: The amount of net income (loss) for the period available to each share of common stock or common unit outstanding during the reporting period and to each share or unit that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of common shares or units for all dilutive potential common shares or units outstanding during the reporting period.

operatingCashFlow.label: 영업현금흐름
operatingCashFlow.definition: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activities, including discontinued operations. Operating activity cash flows include transactions, adjustments, and changes in value not defined as investing or financing activities.

capex.label: 유형자산 투자
capex.definition: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of long-lived, physical assets that are used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale; includes cash outflows to pay for construction of self-constructed assets.

assets.label: 총자산
assets.definition: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all assets that are recognized. Assets are probable future economic benefits obtained or controlled by an entity as a result of past transactions or events.

equity.label: 자기자본
equity.definition: Total of all stockholders' equity (deficit) items, net of receivables from officers, directors, owners, and affiliates of the entity which are attributable to the parent. The amount of the economic entity's stockholders' equity attributable to the parent excludes the amount of stockholders' equity which is allocable to that ownership interest in subsidiary equity which is not attributable to the parent (noncontrolling interest, minority interest). This excludes temporary equity and is sometimes called permanent equity.

cash.label: 현금·현금성자산
cash.definition: Amount of currency on hand as well as demand deposits with banks or financial institutions. Includes other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits. Also includes short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Excludes cash and cash equivalents within disposal group and discontinued operation.

liabilities.label: 총부채
liabilities.definition: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all liabilities that are recognized. Liabilities are probable future sacrifices of economic benefits arising from present obligations of an entity to transfer assets or provide services to other entities in the future.

currentAssets.label: 유동자산
currentAssets.definition: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all assets that are expected to be realized in cash, sold, or consumed within one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer). Assets are probable future economic benefits obtained or controlled by an entity as a result of past transactions or events.

currentLiabilities.label: 유동부채
currentLiabilities.definition: Total obligations incurred as part of normal operations that are expected to be paid during the following twelve months or within one business cycle, if longer.

longTermDebt.label: 장기차입금(표준 태그)
longTermDebt.definition: Amount, after unamortized (discount) premium and debt issuance costs, of long-term debt. Includes, but not limited to, notes payable, bonds payable, debentures, mortgage loans and commercial paper. Excludes capital lease obligations.

stockCompensation.label: 주식보상비용
stockCompensation.definition: Amount of noncash expense for share-based payment arrangement.

dilutedShares.label: 가중평균 희석주식 수
dilutedShares.definition: The average number of shares or units issued and outstanding that are used in calculating diluted EPS or earnings per unit (EPU), determined based on the timing of issuance of shares or units in the period.

operatingMargin.label: 영업이익률
operatingMargin.definition: The net result for the period of deducting operating expenses from operating revenues.

netMargin.label: 순이익률
netMargin.definition: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities; of income (loss) available to common shareholders.

freeCashFlow.label: 단순 잉여현금흐름
freeCashFlow.definition: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activities, including discontinued operations. Operating activity cash flows include transactions, adjustments, and changes in value not defined as investing or financing activities.
freeCashFlow.formula: 영업현금흐름 − 유형자산 취득 지출; 기업의 조정 FCF 정의와 다를 수 있음

notes: SEC 표준 XBRL 태그의 연결 재무 수치입니다. 공시가 수정되면 과거 수치도 바뀔 수 있습니다.
분기 손익은 3개월, 분기 현금흐름은 공시된 연초누적일 수 있습니다. 각 지표의 시작·종료일을 확인하세요.
자료에 없는 표준 지표는 미제공으로 표시합니다. IFRS·은행·보험·리츠의 지표를 일반 제조업과 단순 비교하지 마세요.

operatingIncome.label: 영업이익

netIncome.label: 순이익

eps.label: 희석 EPS

assets.label: 총자산

equity.label: 자기자본
